resumen: Standing, both dumbbells go from shoulder height to overhead. Each arm works on its own, so you start with less weight and more control.
ejecucion: Stand with feet hip-width apart and dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Squeeze glutes and abs so your back does not arch.
Press up until your arms are straight, with the dumbbells over your head and not in front of it.
Lower under control to the shoulders, without letting your wrists bend back.
matices: You lift less weight with dumbbells than with a barbell, and measured deltoid activation is still slightly higher: that is the price of stabilising each side separately. That is activation, not growth — they are not the same thing.
